visual_action: A fast-paced slideshow of mugshots against a black background with a faint image of handcuffs. Each slide features a different man's photo, labeled "CRIMINAL ILLEGAL ALIEN ARRESTED," under the main heading "MINNESOTA WORST OF WORST." A red banner at the bottom of each slide lists the alleged crime(s) associated with the person shown. The White House logo is present at the bottom of the screen throughout.

audio_music: An intense, bass-heavy, and ominous electronic track (DON`T STOP (Slowed++) by GLXXMSTRIDER) plays throughout the video. The pacing of the music is used to time the rapid cuts between the different mugshot slides, creating a tense and alarming atmosphere.
editing_pacing: The video is a rapid slideshow, with cuts between different mugshots occurring every 2-3 seconds, synchronized to the beat of the electronic music.
central_claim: Undocumented immigrants are committing a wave of serious, violent crimes in Minnesota.
intended_effect: To generate fear and anger towards undocumented immigrants and build support for strict deportation policies.
